source_column: County (FSStats rows); County on the Organization record reached from marketbucksUsage._id_site; County (Incoming Call)
transformation: Raw label normalised (trim, lowercase, collapse whitespace, 'saint louis'/'st louis' -> 'st. louis'), then resolved through county_crosswalk.csv to one of 87 Minnesota counties or to (Out of state) / (Unallocated). Metro splits collapse to their parent county; the sub-area is preserved in master_panel_v2_subcounty.csv.
source_definition: County where the food shelf / organization is located, or the Minnesota county associated with the caller's location.
caveat: Every raw label is accounted for in county_crosswalk.csv with a match_type of exact, typo, suffix, ambiguous, non-place or missing. 'cottonwood/brown' named two counties and was assigned to Cottonwood - the only judgement call in the crosswalk.

transformation: '27' + the 3-digit county FIPS, from the reference table in the build script.
caveat: Null for the two non-geographic buckets. Use this to join ACS, SAIPE, BLS or USDA data rather than matching on county name.

transformation: First day of the calendar month.
source_definition: DateForSearch is the first day of the reporting month; Dated is the market session date; Date is the contact date.
caveat: DateForSearch is used rather than _Year/_Month because 26 FSStats rows carry _Month of 0 or 15.

transformation: Summed over every reporting site in the county-month. NaN where fs_site_months = 0.
source_definition: Adult clients (18-64) served during regular (non-special) distributions in the reporting period.
caveat: Monthly headcount, not unique people. 'Reg' excludes the deprecated Extra/Produce/Holiday families, which are 100% null.

transformation: Summed over every reporting site in the county-month. NaN where fs_site_months = 0.
source_definition: Child clients (under 18) served during regular distributions.
caveat: Monthly headcount. Adults + Children + Seniors reconciles to IndividualsReg on complete rows.

transformation: Summed over every reporting site in the county-month. NaN where fs_site_months = 0.
source_definition: Senior clients (65+) served during regular distributions.
caveat: Monthly headcount.

transformation: 4 rows where HouseholdsReg > IndividualsReg * 20 AND IndividualsReg > 0 set to NaN (283847 households removed), then summed. NaN where fs_site_months = 0.
source_definition: Unique households served during regular distributions in the reporting period.
caveat: Unique within the month only. The v1 rule also fired on 9 rows where IndividualsReg was null or zero and the test degenerated; this version requires a usable denominator.

transformation: Summed over every reporting site in the county-month. NaN where fs_site_months = 0.
source_definition: Total individuals (adults + children + seniors) served during regular distributions.
caveat: A demand measure. The glossary is explicit that no dataset here measures need directly.

transformation: 4 rows with negative pounds set to NaN, then summed. NaN where fs_site_months = 0.
source_definition: Total pounds of food distributed during regular distributions.
caveat: Safe to sum across months, unlike the headcounts. Supply-constrained: a site cannot distribute what it does not hold.

transformation: Distinct sites filing a return in the county-month.
caveat: Supply/coverage control. Use it to separate a real change in demand from a change in who reported.

transformation: Row count after de-duplication.
caveat: 0 marks a genuinely unobserved county-month; the FSStats measures are NaN on those rows.

transformation: Summed over every market day in the county-month. NaN where mb_market_days = 0.
source_definition: Dollar value of SNAP benefits distributed or processed as EBT tokens at the market on this date.
caveat: Farmers-market channel only - not county SNAP caseload. Emergency allotments ended after the February 2023 issuance, a structural break.

transformation: Summed over every market day in the county-month. NaN where mb_market_days = 0.
source_definition: Dollar value of SNAP tokens actually redeemed with vendors on this date.
caveat: Missing on 3210 source rows, and tokens can redeem in a later month than issued. A within-month redemption rate is not trustworthy.

transformation: Summed over every market day in the county-month. NaN where mb_market_days = 0.
source_definition: Dollar value of Market Bucks handed to customers, matched to SNAP spending.
caveat: The match is capped at the first 10 dollars per visit, so this is not proportional to SNAPDistributed at volume.

transformation: Summed over every market day in the county-month. NaN where mb_market_days = 0.
source_definition: Dollar value of Market Bucks redeemed with vendors on this date or carried over from prior visits.
caveat: Missing on 3424 source rows; explicitly includes carryover, so it is not time-aligned with MBDistributed.

transformation: Summed over every market day in the county-month. NaN where mb_market_days = 0.
source_definition: Dollar value of Produce Bucks distributed. A supplemental produce incentive distinct from Market Bucks.
caveat: Zero across 2026 year-to-date. Confirm with The Food Group whether the program paused before reading that as a decline.

transformation: Summed over every market day in the county-month. NaN where mb_market_days = 0.
source_definition: Dollar value of Produce Bucks redeemed with vendors.
caveat: Same carryover and missingness caveats as MBRedeemed.

transformation: Summed over every market day in the county-month. NaN where mb_market_days = 0.
source_definition: Unique customers who participated in the Market Bucks program at this market session.
caveat: Unique per session only - summing across sessions counts repeat shoppers again. Read as customer-visits.

transformation: Summed over every market day in the county-month. NaN where mb_market_days = 0.
source_definition: Total individual SNAP transactions processed at the market session, across all program types.
caveat: Counts transactions, not people.

transformation: Distinct market sites reporting in the county-month.
caveat: 37 of the 87 counties never report Market Bucks. Farmers markets are seasonal, so 0 in January and 0 in July mean different things.

transformation: Row count.
caveat: 0 marks an unobserved county-month; the Market Bucks measures are NaN on those rows.

transformation: Count of contact rows per county-month, after dropping 2 duplicate __ID rows.
source_definition: One record per inbound contact to the SNAP helpline - phone, voicemail, text, email or live chat.
caveat: 0 is a true zero for counties with helpline coverage. Stigma means helpline volume understates need.

transformation: Count where either field equals 'SNAP Rx'.
source_definition: SNAP Rx is a healthcare-integrated referral model in which clinical partners refer patients for SNAP enrollment assistance.
caveat: Grew from 25% of contacts in 2023 to 57% in 2026. This is referral-workflow growth, not county demand - keep it out of any demand series.

transformation: contacts_total minus contacts_snap_rx.
caveat: The cleaner demand signal: people who contacted the helpline on their own initiative.

transformation: Count where reason = 'Food Shelf'.
source_definition: Caller is looking for a food shelf.
caveat: The single most direct bridge between the helpline and org_FSStats. 8108 contacts statewide.

transformation: Count where reason is one of Case-Specific Issues, Eligibility Requirements, EBT Card, Application Status, Application Assistance, Recertification, SNAP Changes, Interview, E-SNAP, County Office Details.
source_definition: Benefit-administration questions rather than immediate food need.
caveat: Tracks SNAP churn and county administrative friction, which is a different construct from food need.

transformation: Count where reason = 'SUN Bucks'.
source_definition: SUN Bucks (Summer EBT) provides grocery benefits to school-age children over the summer.
caveat: Strongly seasonal by design.

transformation: Count where reason = 'Farmers market'.
source_definition: Caller is asking about farmers markets.
caveat: Only 262 contacts statewide - too thin for county-month modeling, useful as a qualitative bridge to marketbucksUsage.

transformation: fs_site_months > 0
caveat: Distinguishes a structural zero from an unobserved cell. Filter on this rather than on PoundsReg > 0.

transformation: mb_market_days > 0
caveat: Same purpose for the Market Bucks block.

transformation: contacts_total > 0
caveat: A false here is a real zero, not missing data, for months from 2023-01.

transformation: True for the 87 Minnesota counties, False for (Out of state) and (Unallocated).
caveat: Filter to True for any county-level model. The two False keys exist so panel totals reconcile exactly to source.
The helpline logged only 41 contacts before 2023-01. Restrict any helpline time series to True.
